title: feed.xml must contain an rss root and one channel

spec.name: RSS 2.0
spec.normative_quote: At the top level, a RSS document is a <rss> element, with a mandatory attribute called version, that specifies the version of RSS that the document conforms to.... Subordinate to the <rss> element is a single <channel> element, which contains information about the channel (metadata) and its contents.
spec.note: The validator checks the rss/channel structure here and the version value in feed-xml-version.

applicability: A well-formed XML document served as feed.xml.
expectation: The parsed document has an <rss> root with a <channel> child.

cases.name: a well-formed document with the wrong root
